description: List the Graylog streams the API token can read (id + title, and whether each removes its matches from the Default Stream). To search everything, pass streams:"*" to search/analyze rather than listing streams here. A cluster can hold thousands of streams, so results are capped — use `titleContains` to find one specific named stream (e.g. a service whose logs are absent from the Default Stream).

instance.description: Graylog instance to query. Active: "instance_1". Default: "instance_1".

titleContains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the stream title.

name: list_streams
